05 / EVIDENCE LABWAREHOUSE PHOTOS

Read the evidence, not the hype

A QC photo is useful only when it answers a decision. Scan the whole item first, then inspect the details that would make you keep, exchange or return it.

01

Confirm the identity

Match color, size label, variant and visible accessories.

02

Read the geometry

Look for skewed seams, asymmetry and measurements that affect fit.

03

Zoom with a purpose

Request another angle only if the answer could change the decision.
